description: 白车切断黑王，c兵和g兵协同推进

intro.popup_en: The white rook cuts off the black king along the c-file while the connected c- and g-pawns advance.
intro.popup: 车切断黑王白车在c线切断黑王，配合c、g双兵向前推进。

outro.popup_en: White is winning. The black king is cut off and cannot stop the connected pawns from advancing.
outro.popup: 白方胜势黑王被切断，无法阻止双兵推进。

moves.popup_en: The rook checks from c6 and cuts off the black king at the same time.
moves.popup: 车将军切断！白车占c6，将军同时切断黑王。

moves.popup_en: The black king is forced away from the pawns.
The white king enters the center and directly supports both pawns.
moves.popup: 白王进入中心，直接配合双兵。

moves.popup_en: The black king tries to return and approach the c-pawn.
The c-pawn advances. The connected pawns increase the pressure.
moves.popup: c兵挺进！两兵齐头并进，黑方压力倍增。

moves.popup_en: The black rook gives check to harass White and delay the advance.
moves.popup: 黑车将军骚扰，尝试拖延。

moves.popup_en: The white king steps out of check and continues to support the pawns.
moves.popup: 白王躲开将军，继续保护推进路线。

moves.popup_en: The black rook returns to restrain the c-pawn.
The white king approaches the promotion square; the threat of g8=Q is now urgent.
moves.popup: 白王逼近升变格！g8升变威胁已非常紧迫。
